contacts.name: Himeko
contacts.signature: I can survive without water, but coffee is my lifeblood

202400001.text: While cleaning up the Express's disk files, I found a few repair logs from back when I first boarded the Express

202400002.text: Since you showed some interest in the Express's structure a while back, I decided to send this to you~

202400003.text: The attachment Astral Express Routine Inspection and Maintenance (Draft) has been sent

202400004.text: The attachment Astral Express Routine Inspection and Maintenance (Annotated) has been sent

202400005.text: The attachment Astral Express Routine Inspection and Maintenance (Illustrated) has been sent

202400006.text: Don't mind the names, they're nothing too serious. Just standard train repair logs

202400007.text: At the time, I just wanted to name them in a way that if the conductor found them by accident... would show I was trustworthy

202400008.text: How could the conductor not trust Himeko!

202400009.text: Well, I was still a newbie back then, so my understanding of the Express was pretty subjective...

202400010.text: Are you saying the illustrated version was hand-drawn by you!?

202400011.text: Yes, drawing it by hand is an additional way of remembering the structure and details of the Express

202400012.text: It's just that back then, my understanding of the Express was still a bit immature and subjective...

202400013.text: Are these really standard train repair logs?

202400014.text: Yeah! I just recorded a few issues encountered during practical use

202400015.text: After all, my understanding of the Express back then was still a bit immature and subjective...

202400016.text: One time, based on calculations of the Express's average speed, I tweaked the step-down transformer's sensor chip and installed an autopilot system, aiming to make operations more efficient and effortless

202400017.text: What I didn't see coming was that the conductor and I would be so free that we actually fell asleep piloting. So, I changed it back immediately

202400018.text: What else... The repair log appendix... research records on the piloting styles and habits of Navigators from past eras

202400019.text: Zero-effort autopilot is totally my thing, it's my turn to pilot the Astral Express next!

202400020.text: Sure! When I have some time later, I'll install an easy-to-use dual system

202400021.text: It's been a long time since I've made such a major adjustment. To be honest, I'm already looking forward to it

202400022.text: What is Himeko's piloting style like?

202400023.text: Probably way more calm and composed compared to the past... right?

202400025.text: I actually prefer repairing vehicles to piloting them

202400026.text: You know, back when I used to stay up all night working on blueprints and repairs, I once drank over a dozen cups of coffee in a row

202400027.text: Thinking back now, I miss those times. I haven't been that motivated in a long while

202400028.text: I could take you with me for the Express's next maintenance, if you'd like
